density.note: peak recomputed with each cell’s area in EPSG:25830 (≈ 0.01 km² ± projection distortion)

centre.note: direct sum over places inside the frame (C1 is > 3 km from the frame edge, so the margin cannot change it)

human.note: targets clipped to the frame + 50 m in the data file, so cells near the edge may differ slightly
